protocol: Two P2 arms with matching focus and observed F2 within each arm. GT arm reconstructs second-pass candidates in center geometry, then reapplies order to C7 front and rear. C7 adds GT depth1/depth2 only on valid-dual GT mixed color support. Outside that support both GT methods share pinhole center depth, with frozen predicted depth as a fallback only on invalid center hits. Cross-arm C7/C6 is reported only on common valid-dual split pixels.
